question: A chord of length 12 cm subtends an angle of 30 degrees at the circumference of a circle. What is the shortest distance from the center of the circle to this chord?
solution: Given: Length of chord = 12 cm Angle subtended at circumference = 30° Formula used: Angle at center = 2 × angle at circumference Chord length = 2R × sin(θ/2)
